metadata.description:
Originally posted to alt.binaries.old.nl by MeiMei.


******************************************************************************
Welcome to the Nebula CDROM for NeXTSTEP Intel.
******************************************************************************

Nebula Second Edition
June 1994
Version 2.0

Compilation editor: Eric "E.T." Tremblay

Thank you:
I would like to thank you the customer for purchasing this CDROM disc. Without
you, there would not be a disc.

To all authors:
Thank you to all the authors and companies that provided the material found on
this disc.

To everyone including ShareWare and PD authors:
Please encourage ShareWare authors and remember to thank all the authors of
public domain software. We appreciate all their work, effort and talent.
Don't just think about it, do it!


******************************************************************************

APPS        Applications

    ARCHIVEU    Archive Utilities - Compression and uncompression utilities
    ASTRO        Astronomy and Astrology
    AUDIOAPP    AudioApps - Audio applications
    CLOCKS        Clocks and various calendar utilities
    COMMUNIC    Communications utilities
    DEVTOOLS    Developer Tools
    EDUCATIO    Educational applications
    EMACSTEX    Emacs & TeX - Public domain and Shareware
    FINANCIA    Financial - Money, money and $$$$$
    GAMES        Unix and NeXTSTEP games
    GRAPHICS    Graphics viewers, utilities etc...
    MAIL        The electronic mailbox...
    MISC        Anything goes...
    SCREENSA    ScreenSavers - Applications and BackSpace modules
    UTILITIE    Utilities - All sorts of utilities

AUDIO        Audio files

    SCORE        Music Score files.
    SOUND        Sound files in NeXT SND format
    THE_NEXT    The NeXT Wave - A song by Nathan J. & the NeXTsteps in SND format.

DEMO        This folder contains commercial demo's

    COMM        Comm
    GRAPHICS    Graphics
    LIGHTHOU    Lighthouse
    SPREADSH    SpreadSheets
    UTILITY        Utility    
    OTHER        Other demos
    
DOCUMENT    Documents

    ASTROLOG    AstrologyFiles - Astrology personnality description text files.
    CONCURRE    Concurrence - Thare the files that will be used for my NEXTSTEP Presentation hopefuly in January 94.
    DIAGRAM        These files are to be used in Diagram! by LightHouse Design.
    FAQ            Frequently Asked Questions
    MEDIAVIE    Multi-Media documents to use with MediaView.
    OTHERS        Other documents.
    PRESSRE0    PressReleases93 - Press Releases
    PRESSRE1    PressReleases94 - Press Releases
    WHITEPAP    White Papers - PostScript documents

FONTS        These are PD and Shareware fonts for NeXT.

GENIE        All about the GEnie Information Service

GRAPHICS    Graphics

    GIF            Gif - Graphics!
    ICONS        Icons - Graphics!
    LOGINPAN    LoginPanels, please add color to them! LoginPanels replacement.
    MOVIES        Graphic animations with Movie!
    MPEG        Graphic animations
    POSTSCRI    PostScript in PS and EPS format.
    RIBS        RenderMan RIB files
    TIFF        Tiff graphic file
    
NEWSLETT    Newsletters

    COMP_SYS    comp.sys.next.announce - Press Releases etc...
    GENIEUNI    GEnieUnixNewsletter - A newsletter published by the Unix RT on the GEnie Information Service
    LAMPS        Lamps - A newsletter published by the IBM RT on the GEnie Information Service
    NEXTNUGG    NeXTNuggetNewsDigest - Latest NeXT news from NeXT
    VARIOUS        Various newsletters

PC            This directory contains PD and shareware software for the IBM and compatibles computers.

    ASTRO        Astronomy and Astrology
    BUSINESS    Business applications for the IBM and compatible computers
    COMPRESS    File compression utilities for the IBM compatible computers.
    C            PCC  A Personal C Compiler Version 2.1c
    DOSHELP        PC/MS-DOS, The Essentials
    EDITOR        QEdit Advanced Version 2.1
    GRAPHICS    Graphics
    PROGRAMS    Programs
    PTOMB        Pharaoh's Tomb Version 3.0    
    TERMPROG    Communications for the IBM compatible computers.    
    UTILITY        Utilities
    VIRUS        IBM VIRUS SOFTWARE
    GENIE        GEnie LIVEWIRE

SOURCECO    SourceCode - Programming!


.
.

note:

  PowerGloveInspector
  Version 0.1 (beta) by Gareth S. Bestor
  This application displays the current state of a Nintendo/Mattel
  PowerGlove (tm) attached to the DSP port of a NeXTcube or
  NeXTstation computer. PowerGlove Inspector does not work on
  non-NeXT (i.e. Intel) hardware.
  Includes source code
